Run Non-Demographic Herd Module Pipeline

Source: R/run_nondemographic_herd_module.R
run_nondemographic_herd_module.Rd

This function takes herd- and cohort-level non-demographic inputs and simulates production-cycle dynamics for the non-demographic cohorts used in the Global Livestock Environmental Assessment Model (GLEAM) computational pipeline run_gleam(). It computes phase-specific average stock sizes and offtake numbers. Annual average stock and offtake include animals that entered before the assessment year, so productive phases can span year boundaries. Stock is returned unscaled; run_all_herd_module() applies any supplied herd-size target.

Usage

run_nondemographic_herd_module(
  cohort_level_data,
  herd_level_data,
  simulation_duration = 365,
  show_indicator = TRUE
)

Arguments

cohort_level_data

A data.table with one row per herd, cohort, and productive phase, and the following mandatory columns:

herd_id

Character. Unique identifier for the herd, repeated for each cohort belonging to the same herd.

cohort_short

Character. Sex-specific cohort code describing the age and/or the production stage of the animals. Supported values include:

  • FN: non-demographic females

  • MN: non-demographic males

nondemo_productive_phase_id

Numeric. Identifier of the productive phase for non-demographic cohorts (FN, MN). Takes value 1 for phase 1 and optionally 2 for phase 2.

death_rate

Numeric. Fraction of animals dying in the assessed cohort over the productive phase for non-demographic cohorts (fraction).

cohort_duration_days is not required for FN and MN when phase durations are supplied in the herd table.

herd_level_data

A data.table with one row per herd, and the following mandatory columns:

herd_id

Character. Unique identifier for the herd.

cohort_stock_fem_annual_nondemo

Numeric. Annual number of female animals entering the non-demographic pathway (FN) over the 365-time horizon (# heads).

cohort_stock_mal_annual_nondemo

Numeric. Annual number of male animals entering the non-demographic pathway (MN) over the 365-time horizon (# heads).

rest_between_nondemo_cycles_duration

Numeric. Duration of the resting or empty phase between non-demographic cycles (days). Use 0 when there is no rest between cycles.

phase1_nondemo_fem_duration_days

Numeric. Duration of productive phase 1 for the female non-demographic cohort (FN) (days).

phase2_nondemo_fem_duration_days

Numeric. Duration of productive phase 2 for the female non-demographic cohort (FN) (days).

phase1_nondemo_mal_duration_days

Numeric. Duration of productive phase 1 for the male nondemographic cohort (MN) (days).

phase2_nondemo_mal_duration_days

Numeric. Duration of productive phase 2 for the male non-demographic cohort (MN) (days).

simulation_duration

Numeric. Length of the assessment period (days).

show_indicator

Logical. Whether to display progress indicators during simulation. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

A named list with two elements:

cohort_level_results

A data.table with one row per retained herd, non-demographic cohort block, and productive phase, containing the original cohort_level_data columns plus:

cohort_duration_days

Numeric. Amount of time that each animal spends in a specific cohort and production phase (days). For CHK, suggested value for FJ and MJ cohorts: 3 days. Not required for FN and MN when phase durations are supplied in the herd table; the code fills it from the herd values, which override any cohort values.

cohort_stock_size_unscaled

Numeric. Average population size of the assessed cohort, not scaled to the total livestock population (herd_size_total) (# heads).

partial_nondemo_phase_duration

Numeric. Duration of the terminal partial productive phase falling within the fixed 365-day non-demographic simulation horizon (days).

offtake_heads_unscaled

Numeric. Total number of animals removed from each cohort over the full 365-day simulation horizon, not scaled to the cohort population at the start of the assessment (# heads).

offtake_heads_assessment_unscaled

Numeric. Total number of animals removed from each cohort over the assessment period, not scaled to the cohort population at the start of the assessment (# heads/assessment period).

number_full_nondemo_cycles

Integer. Number of complete cycles fully contained within the fixed 365-day time horizon for the assessed non-demographic cohort (FN or MN) (# cycles).

total_nondemo_cycle_starts_to_distribute

Integer. Total number of cycle starts within the fixed 365-day time horizon for the assessed non-demographic cohort (FN or MN) (# cycle starts).

herd_level_results

A data.table with one row per herd_id containing the original herd_level_data columns plus:

total_nondemo_fem_duration_days

Numeric. Total duration of the productive non-demographic phases assigned to the female non-demographic cohort block (FN) (days).

total_nondemo_mal_duration_days

Numeric. Total duration of the productive non-demographic phases assigned to the male non-demographic cohort block (MN) (days).

Details

The function operates over a 365-day simulation horizon to maintain consistency with the demographic herd module. For each herd and non-demographic cohort block, it computes how many complete production cycles fit within the horizon, whether an additional partial cycle is present, and how annual entrants should be distributed across cycle starts.

A key feature of this implementation is that it applies mortality at the phase level. Phase-level mortality fractions are converted to implied daily mortality probabilities, and the resulting daily survival is used to compute end-of-phase stock, average stock over the horizon, and total offtake.

Model structure

The non-demographic population is divided into two cohort blocks:

  • FN: non-demographic female animals

  • MN: non-demographic male animals

Each cohort block may contain up to two sequential productive phases, identified by nondemo_productive_phase_id = 1 and optionally nondemo_productive_phase_id = 2. A resting period between cycles is supplied at herd level through rest_between_nondemo_cycles_duration.

Dynamics and parameters

Non-demographic herd dynamics result from:

  • annual entrants into each non-demographic cohort block

  • mortality during each productive phase (death_rate)

  • phase duration (cohort_duration_days), either supplied directly in the cohort table or derived later from herd-level phase-duration inputs

  • the duration of the resting period between cycles

For each herd and cohort block, the function:

  1. identifies phase 1 and optional phase 2 from cohort_level_data

  2. computes cycle geometry using calc_nondemo_cycle_geometry

  3. distributes annual entrants across cycle starts using calc_nondemo_start_sizes

  4. simulates stock dynamics within each phase using calc_nondemo_phase

  5. computes average stock over the assessment horizon using calc_nondemo_avg_stock_phase_horizon

  6. computes total and assessment-window offtake using calc_nondemo_offtake_total_horizon

See also

calc_nondemo_cycle_geometry, calc_nondemo_start_sizes, calc_nondemo_phase, calc_nondemo_avg_stock_phase_horizon, calc_nondemo_offtake_total_horizon

Examples

# \donttest{
# Load non-demographic herd simulation inputs (FN/MN cohorts and annual entrants)
nondemo_chrt_dt <- data.table::fread(system.file(
  "extdata/run_modules_examples/nondemographic_herd_input_chrt_data.csv",
  package = "gleam"
))
nondemo_hrd_dt <- data.table::fread(system.file(
  "extdata/run_modules_examples/nondemographic_herd_input_hrd_data.csv",
  package = "gleam"
))

# Run non-demographic herd simulation
results <- run_nondemographic_herd_module(
  cohort_level_data = nondemo_chrt_dt,
  herd_level_data = nondemo_hrd_dt,
  simulation_duration = 365,
  show_indicator = TRUE
)
#> 🕒 Simulating the non-demographic herd, please wait…
#> ✔ Non-demographic herd simulation complete.
# }
